prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create one production-quality 1536 x 1024 pixel desktop UI mockup for StoryDream Vox. Current date 2026-10-22. Attached image is the ACTUAL CURRENT PRODUCT SCREENSHOT and visual grounding. Preserve the product's Fluent desktop look while simplifying its main generation workflow. Charcoal base #101214, raised surfaces #1b1f23, off-white #f4f6f8, muted #b1b8be, coral #f2614b, restrained 6px control radii, readable Chinese UI at 14-16px. No browser chrome, no whole-app floating card, no nested cards, no marketing hero, no invented metrics.

Direction: a guided production flow, source-first, for a complete beginner before a run. Show a meaningful, calm content creation screen, not a feature inventory. Top 56px app bar has back arrow, StoryDream, project name “城市为什么更热”, quiet saved state. Under it a short progress line “准备内容  /  自动制作  /  检查成片”, with “准备内容” current. No permanently visible right settings sidebar and no navigation clutter.

Main content centered within the app, generous padding, in two clear regions divided by whitespace. Left 58%: heading “把文案变成一条 Vox 动画”, a persistent field label “文案或主题”, and a large editable text area with realistic three-paragraph Chinese narration about urban heat islands. Supporting action only “导入文稿”. Below the text area a single compact row “横屏 16:9” and “旁白：自动选择”. An understated disclosure “更多设置” is collapsed.

Right 42%: heading “选择制作预设”. Show exactly three compact selectable rows, each with a beautiful realistic photographic paper-collage thumbnail, plain title, and one-line outcome description. Titles exactly “纸拼贴讲解” selected, “数据与地图”, “档案叙事”. Selected row gets a thin coral left line, not a huge colored card. Show one larger 16:9 preview below the selected preset with photographic city towers, cut-paper sun, greenery, halftone heat pattern and orange paper accents. No abstract square placeholders. Label it “风格预览”. Place a quiet text action “逐步自定义” below the preview. Do not show effect catalogs, render engines, seeds, code, scene templates, JSON, queue, multiple generate buttons.

Fixed 76px bottom PROJECT ACTION BAR: left reads “画面、配音、字幕、合成将自动完成” with secondary line “生成前会检查模型与素材”. At far right the sole coral primary button “一键生成成片”; next to it a subdued link “查看制作计划”. No extra confirmation button. Do not imply a completed film already exists. Use strong hierarchy, clean grouping, sensible space, restrained separators, no clipped labels.
